name: add a hydra mode override that shortens training epochs
definition: Introduce a debug mode which, when selected via an override, sets a debug flag, a small batch, and a one-epoch training while keeping other defaults.
failure_mode: wrong flag or epoch value fails the render comparison

name: apply format constraints while enumerating candidates
definition: only retain candidate strings conforming to the described scheme (exact length, required start/end fragments, uppercase letters/digits only), writing each matching candidate to the result list instead of guessing the final unique value.
failure_mode: not writing candidates or losing the matching one by tightening the format fails the match

name: apply temporal/date-based filters against a fixed reference date
definition: Constrain records using date predicates evaluated against a given reference date so only currently-valid facts are considered.
failure_mode: Ignoring or misusing the date predicate keeps outdated facts in the results.

name: author a stan model for hierarchical bayesian beta-binomial
definition: write a Stan program encoding per-group binomial likelihood, beta group priors, and a Jeffreys-type hyper-prior over the alpha/beta pair.
failure_mode: syntax or semantic error fails the model parse test
